target: Remove context-capsule acknowledgement writes and preserve compatible, read-only runtime refresh.
primary_semantics: Detect only the latest deterministic refresh transition, derive a stable refresh id, keep capsule rendering read-only and idempotent, and retain the legacy acknowledgement command as a no-write compatibility no-op.
invariants: Raw conversations, summaries, indexes, cloud exchange, and backup data remain unchanged.
Historical retrieval never depends on a context-capsule acknowledgement.
Repeated reads of the same capsule produce identical output and perform no write.
Cloud exchange acknowledgements remain outside this context-refresh change.
allowed_changes: Change runtime context-refresh trigger calculation, capsule metadata, Skill instructions, compatibility ACK behavior, tests, documentation, and release metadata.
prohibited_changes: Change summary triggers, semantic generation, raw archive formats, device trust, cloud ACK protocols, project evidence, or dashboard behavior.
Add a new permission rule, archive lock, state file, background service, or user authorization step for capsule reads.
before_after_checks: The same capsule can be read twice with byte-identical output while the archive lock is held.
No context-refresh state file is created by status, capsule, or legacy ACK calls.
A utilization threshold triggers only on the latest crossing and not on every later above-threshold event.
The legacy ACK command returns not-required without writing.
Skill and all three READMEs state that capsule reads require no acknowledgement.

original_triggers: A read-only capsule load was incorrectly followed by a required acknowledgement write.
A sandbox denial for that derived write was incorrectly reported as a retrieval blocker.
